01-command-sheet.html.note: Implemented in ratatui on herdr-app's own client layer (hc.rs, copied, Apache-2.0). One header row: session left, core + connection glyph + switch/close right. Panel: counted TABS section with agent rows hosted by their terminal and helpers nested, AGENTS rollup, preview, dim footer actions. Selection is a surface band, no selection glyph. Rail 26 cols on the left at >=60 cols, full-screen sheet below that. No status bar. 104 tests, clippy clean. Terminal area shows terminal.read tails until the attach stream (T5).
